# Test pointwise response-quality ranking before pairwise work

::: {.hub-record-hero .hub-idea-hero}
<p class="hub-idea-status">Completed · High priority · 9/9 readiness fields complete</p>

<p class="hub-takeaway">Transfer audited response-quality labels to development requests, compare the resulting rankings with the frozen dense control, and stop before pairwise judging when the gate fails.</p>
<p>Response quality could add evidence that query similarity misses, but supplied references and pointwise judges are not organizer gold and must earn downstream value.</p>

<p class="hub-github-issue"><a href="https://github.com/npatta01/trec_mlm_2026/issues/31">Track in GitHub #31</a></p>

<details class="hub-details">
<summary>Evidence and current knowledge</summary>
## How does it work?

- Join the audited support labels to the frozen candidate-local E5 neighbors without organizer qrels.
- Construct prior, routing-residual, pointwise-only, and dense-fused rankings under the frozen Phase 0 protocol.
- Evaluate once on all 322 development queries and authorize pairwise work only if every effectiveness gate passes.

## What do we know?

The completed Phase 0 study found that neither the pointwise-only ranking nor
its fixed dense fusion improved the control. The supplied evidence remains a
provisional judging pivot rather than organizer gold. Four of five gates failed,
so the recorded action is `stop_pairwise_work`.
</details>
